summary: A cart total with per-line discounts is added next to the existing subtotal.

defects.why: The loop reads lines[lines.length], which is undefined: every call throws a TypeError on line.quantity.
The line is charged the discount instead of the price minus the discount, and a line without a discount becomes NaN.

decoys.why: Loose equality with null is deliberate: it treats null and undefined alike and keeps a quantity of 0, as the doc comment states; `||` would turn 0 into 1.
